rich_narrative.summary: In FY2025, ICNAB reported <cite id="3">Total Revenue of $3,851,438</cite> to support Bosniak Islamic centers across North America. The organization allocated a <cite id="1">Program expense ratio of 97.3%</cite> directly toward its core operations and member centers. Financial analysis shows <cite id="1">9.2 months of working capital</cite>, providing solid financial stability. However, revenue saw a recent drop, shifting from <cite id="3">$4,520,145 in FY2023</cite> down to <cite id="3">$4,243,273 in FY2024</cite>. ICNAB operates with zero reported fundraising costs and maintains a 100% independent board, but it lacks a formal documented theory of change and has limited public disclosure on specific governance policies. Giving to this organization is classified as sadaqah-eligible.
